## Declarations {.unnumbered}

**Funding.** This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

**Competing interests.** The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

**Ethics approval.** The study uses anonymized public-use survey data; no ethics approval was required.

**Consent to participate and for publication.** Not applicable. The study uses anonymized public-use survey data in which respondents gave consent to the survey agencies; no individual can be identified.

**Data availability.** The PIAAC Cycle 2 public-use files are available from the OECD (https://www.oecd.org/skills/piaac/). The analysis code, the dated analysis plan and the run record are held in a GitHub repository and will be made public upon publication.

**Author contributions.** Garen Avanesian: Conceptualization, Data curation, Formal analysis, Methodology, Software, Visualization, Writing – original draft, Writing – review and editing.

**Use of artificial intelligence.** During the preparation of this work, the author, who is not a native English speaker, used Claude Code to copyedit the manuscript and optimize the R code for the reproducible analytical pipeline used to produce this paper. The author reviewed and edited the material and takes responsibility for the final content.
